press_references.value: Handl Health provides carriers, TPAs with end-to-end platform to create alternative health plans

product_launches.description: Handl Health expanded its health plan design platform to serve as an end-to-end solution for carriers and TPAs to create variable-copay alternative health plans, integrating networks, performance data, and episode bundles into a unified analytic and pricing layer.

overview_description.description: Handl Health is a technology platform transforming how health plans are evaluated, designed and managed. By unifying healthcare pricing, utilization, benefit and quality data into a single analytical and operational layer, Handl empowers  brokers, carriers and third-party administrators  to build flexible, cost-effective health benefits. Handl’s technology delivers the infrastructure, analytics and insights needed to power the next generation of alternative health plans.

product.name: Arke
product.description: An API-based technology that delivers real-time healthcare cost and out-of-pocket information through member-facing benefits portals and other care-navigation tools.

product.description: An analytics layer for carriers and third-party administrators to design and manage alternative health plans using carrier rates, provider data, claims, quality, outcomes, and episode bundles.
